name: article-card
title: Article card
description: A post or article preview as a single link: cover, topic, date, headline, summary, author and reading time, vertical or horizontal.
docs: href, title, excerpt, image ({ src, alt?, width?, height?, placeholder? }), category, author ({ name, image? }), date, readingTime and orientation. The headline is the link and its target stretches over the whole card, so a click anywhere on it opens the article (the text on it cannot be selected by dragging) and the focus ring goes around the whole card. The cover is boxed in a fixed shape (aspect, default 1.6) from the first paint, with a blurred placeholder behind it (a tiny data URL, the way Next.js hands one over), so a list never jumps while pictures arrive; media replaces the plain img with your own element, such as next/image with fill. The headline is cut to two lines and the summary to three, and the author sits at the bottom, so cards of different lengths line up in a grid. date becomes a time element written with locale and timeZone (default en-US and UTC; a date-only string such as 2026-10-14 is a calendar day, written as that day in any zone and kept as it is in datetime). orientation horizontal puts the picture beside the text once the card itself is 40rem wide, by container query, and stacks it in a narrower one. titleAs sets the heading element. It is a Server Component.
